source: IMPROVED SAMPLING VIA LEARNED DIFFUSIONS
translation: 通过学习扩散改进采样

source: ABSTRACT
translation: 摘要

source: Recently, a series of papers proposed deep learning-based approaches to sample from target distributions using controlled diffusion processes, being trained only on the unnormalized target densities without access to samples. Building on previous work, we identify these approaches as special cases of a generalized Schr¨odinger bridge problem, seeking a stochastic evolution between a given prior distribution and the specified target. We further generalize this framework by introducing a variational formulation based on divergences between path space measures of timereversed diffusion processes. This abstract perspective leads to practical losses that can be optimized by gradient-based algorithms and includes previous objectives as special cases. At the same time, it allows us to consider divergences other than the reverse Kullback-Leibler divergence that is known to suffer from mode collapse. In particular, we propose the so-called log-variance loss, which exhibits favorable numerical properties and leads to significantly improved performance across all considered approaches.

source: 1.1 RELATED WORK
translation: 1.1 相关工作

source: There exists a myriad of Monte Carlo-based methods for sampling from unnormalized densities, e.g. Annealed Importance Sampling (AIS) (Neal, 2001), Sequential Monte Carlo (Del Moral et al., 2006; Doucet et al., 2009) (SMC), or Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) (Kass et al., 1998). Note, however, that MCMC methods are usually only guaranteed to reach the target density asymptotically, and the convergence speed might be too slow in many practical settings (Robert et al., 1999). Variational methods such as mean-field approximations (Wainwright et al., 2008) and normalizing flows (Papamakarios et al., 2021; Wu et al., 2020; Midgley et al., 2023; Vaitl et al., 2024) provide an alternative. Similar to our setting, the problem of density estimation is cast into an optimization problem by fitting a parametric family of tractable distributions to the target density.
translation: 存在大量基于蒙特卡洛的方法用于从未归一化的密度中进行采样，例如退火重要性采样（AIS）（Neal，2001年），序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）（Del Moral等人，2006年；Doucet等人，2009年），或者马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）（Kass等人，1998年）。需要注意的是，MCMC方法通常仅保证渐近地达到目标密度，而在许多实用场景下，其收敛速度可能过慢（Robert等人，1999年）。变分方法，如平均场近似（Wainwright等人，2008年）和归一化流（Papamakarios等人，2021年；Wu等人，2020年；Midgley等人，2023年；Vaitl等人，2024年），提供了另一种选择。类似于我们的设置，密度估计问题被转化为一个通过拟合参数化的可处理分布族到目标密度的优化问题。

source: We build our theoretical foundation on the variational formulation of bridge problems proposed by Chen et al. (2021a). We recall that the underlying ideas were established decades ago (Nelson, 1967; Anderson, 1982; Haussmann & Pardoux, 1986; F¨ollmer, 1988), however, only recently applied to diffusion models (Song et al., 2020) and SBs (Vargas, 2021; Liu et al., 2022). While the numerical treatment of SB problems has classically been approached via iterative nested schemes, the approach in Chen et al. (2021a) uses backward SDEs (BSDEs) to arrive at a single objective based on a KL divergence. This objective includes the (continuous-time) ELBO of diffusion models (Huang et al., 2021) as a special case, which can also be approached from the perspective of optimal control (Berner et al., 2024). For additional previous work on optimal control in the context of generative modeling, we refer to De Bortoli et al. (2021); Tzen & Raginsky (2019); Pavon (2022); Holdijk et al. (2022).
translation: 我们理论基础建立在Chen等人（2021a）提出的桥问题的变分表述之上。回顾一下，这些基本思想几十年前就已经确立（Nelson，1967年；Anderson，1982年；Haussmann & Pardoux，1986年；Föllmer，11988年），然而，直到最近才被应用于扩散模型（Song等人，2020年）和SBs（Vargas，2021年；Liu等人，2022年）。虽然SB问题的经典数值处理通常是通过迭代嵌套方案来实现的，但Chen等人（2021a）的方法使用倒向随机微分方程（BSDEs）来得出一个基于KL发散的单一目标。这个目标包括扩散模型的（连续时间）ELBO（Huang等人，2021年）作为一个特殊情况，也可以从最优控制的角度来探讨（Berner等人，2024年）。关于生成建模上下文中的最优控制的先前工作，我们参考De Bortoli等人（2021年）；Tzen & Raginsky（2019年）；Pavon（2022年）；Holdijk等人（2022年）。

source: Crucially, we note that our path space perspective on the variational formulation of bridges has not been known before. Our novel derivation only relies on time-reversals of diffusion processes and shows that, in general, corresponding losses (in particular the one in Chen et al. (2021a)) do not have a unique solution as they lack the entropy constraint of classical SB problems. However, in special cases, we recover unique objectives corresponding to recently developed sampling methods, e.g., DIS, DDS, and PIS. Moreover, the path space perspective allows us to extend the variational formulation of bridges to different divergences, in particular to the log-variance divergence that has originally been introduced in N¨usken & Richter (2021). Variants of this loss have previously only been analyzed in the context of variational inference (Richter et al., 2020) and neural solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs) (Richter & Berner, 2022). Extending these works, we prove that the beneficial properties of the log-variance loss also hold for the general bridge objective, which incorporates two instead of only one controlled stochastic process. Finally, we refer to Vargas et al. (2024) for concurrent work on the path space perspective on diffusion-based sampling.
translation: 至关重要的是，我们注意到从路径空间视角对桥梁问题的变分表述尚未被先前的研究所知。我们的新颖推导仅依赖于扩散过程的时间反转，并表明，一般而言，相应的损失函数（特别是Chen等人(2021a)中的一个）没有唯一解，因为它们缺乏经典SB问题中的熵约束。然而，在特殊情况下，我们恢复了与最近开发的采样方法相对应的独特目标，例如DIS、DDS和PIS。此外，路径空间视角使我们能够将桥梁问题的变分表述扩展到不同的发散度，特别是最初由Nüsken & Richter (2021)引入的对数方差发散度。这种损失函数的变体之前仅在变分推断(Richter等, 2020)和偏微分方程(PDEs)的神经求解器(Richter & Berner, 2022)的背景下进行过分析。在此基础上，我们证明了对数方差损失的良好性质也适用于包含两个而非一个受控随机过程的一般桥梁目标。最后，我们参考Vargas等(2024)关于基于扩散的采样的路径空间视角的同期工作。

source: 1.2 OUTLINE OF THE ARTICLE
translation: 1.2 文章概述

source: The rest of the article is organized as follows. In Section 2, we provide an introduction to diffusionbased sampling from the perspective of path space measures and time-reversed SDEs. This can be understood as a unifying framework allowing for generalizations to divergences other than the KL divergence. We propose the log-variance divergence and prove that it exhibits superior properties. In Section 3, we will subsequently outline multiple novel connections to known methods, such as SBs in Section 3.1, diffusion-based generative modeling (i.e., DIS) in Section 3.2, and approaches based on reference processes (i.e., PIS and DDS) in Section 3.3. For all considered methods, we can find compelling numerical evidence for the superiority of the log-variance divergence, see Section 4.

source: 5 CONCLUSION
translation: 5 结论

source: In this work, we provide a unifying perspective on diffusion-based generative modeling that is based on path space measures of time-reversed diffusion processes and that, for the first time, connects methods such as SB, DIS, PIS, and DDS. Our novel framework also allows us to consider arbitrary divergences between path measures as objectives for the corresponding task of interest. While the KL divergence yields known methods, we find that choosing the log-variance divergence leads to novel algorithms that are particularly useful for the task of sampling from (unnormalized) densities. Specifically, this divergence exhibits beneficial properties, such as lower variance, computational efficiency, and exploration-exploitation trade-offs. We can demonstrate in multiple numerical examples that the log-variance loss greatly improves sampling quality across a range of metrics. We believe that problem and approach-specific finetuning might further enhance the performance of the log-variance loss, thereby paving the way for competitive diffusion-based sampling approaches.
translation: 在这项工作中，我们提供了一个基于时间反向扩散过程路径空间测度的统一视角来理解扩散生成模型，并首次将SB、DIS、PIS和DDS等方法联系起来。我们的新框架还允许我们将任意路径测度之间的发散作为相应任务的目标。虽然KL发散产生了已知的方法，但我们发现选择对数方差发散可以产生特别适用于从（未归一化）密度中采样的新颖算法。具体而言，这种发散表现出有益的特性，如较低的方差、计算效率以及探索与利用之间的权衡。我们可以在多个数值示例中证明，对数方差损失在一系列度量上极大地提高了采样质量。我们认为，针对特定问题和方法的具体微调可能会进一步提升对数方差损失的性能，从而为具有竞争力的扩散采样方法铺平道路。
